airplane: Airplanes appear as elongated metallic objects with distinct fuselage, wings, and tail, parked on hardstand areas. They differ from airports by being discrete aircraft rather than the entire aviation facility; runways show linear pavement without aircraft shape; parking lots show vehicle rows without aircraft structures.
airport: Airports show long, straight runways with distinct markings, connected to large terminal buildings and hangars. They differ from runways by including terminal buildings and parking areas; railway stations show train tracks and platforms rather than runways; thermal power stations show cooling towers and industrial structures rather than aviation facilities.
baseball_diamond: Baseball diamonds show diamond-shaped infields with visible pitcher's mound, baselines, and outfield grass. They differ from golf courses by having sports diamond geometry rather than fairways and bunkers; stadiums have large surrounding stands; ground track fields show oval running tracks rather than diamond infields.
basketball_court: Basketball courts show rectangular paved areas with clear court markings, center circle, and key areas. They differ from tennis courts by having different court markings without nets; parking lots show vehicle rows rather than court markings; roundabouts show circular traffic patterns rather than sports courts.
beach: Beaches appear as sandy shorelines along water bodies with light colors and wave patterns. They contrast with islands by being coastal shorelines rather than land surrounded by water; deserts show inland sand without water adjacency; sea ice shows frozen white surfaces rather than sandy shores.
bridge: Bridges show elevated roadway or railway structures spanning over water or valleys. They differ from harbors by being crossing structures rather than waterfront docks; freeways are ground-level corridors without span structures; rivers show water channels without bridges.
chaparral: Chaparral appears as dense, low, dark-green shrub vegetation with irregular edges covering hillsides. It contrasts with deserts by having dense vegetation rather than sand dunes; forests have taller tree canopy; mountains show exposed rock and elevation rather than uniform shrub cover.
church: Churches show distinctive religious architecture with prominent spires, steeples, or domes. They differ from palaces by having religious spires rather than ornate palace architecture; commercial areas show retail buildings rather than churches; medium residential shows housing units without religious structures.
circular_farmland: Circular farmland shows large pivot-irrigated fields with concentric circular patterns. It differs from rectangular farmland by having circular geometry rather than straight field boundaries; storage tanks show metallic circular containers rather than crop circles; terraces show stepped agricultural patterns on slopes.
cloud: Clouds appear as bright white to gray irregular masses with soft edges in the sky. They differ from mountains by lacking solid ground and elevation; sea ice shows frozen surface patterns rather than atmospheric formations; snowberg shows snow-covered peaks rather than clouds.
commercial_area: Commercial areas show dense retail and office buildings with large parking lots and storefronts. They contrast with industrial areas by having retail rather than warehouses; palaces show ornate architecture rather than commercial blocks; dense residential shows housing units rather than commercial buildings.
dense_residential: Dense residential features tightly packed housing units with small yards and narrow streets. It differs from medium residential by having smaller lot sizes; mobile home parks show narrow trailer units rather than houses; commercial areas show retail buildings rather than residences.
desert: Deserts show vast, barren landscapes with sand dunes and sparse dry vegetation. They contrast with chaparral by lacking dense shrub vegetation; mountains show elevated rocky peaks; beaches show coastal sandy areas adjacent to water.
forest: Forests show dense tree canopy with dark green textures and no visible ground. They contrast with chaparral by having taller trees rather than low shrubs; meadows show open grassy areas without tree cover; wetlands show water-saturated ground rather than dense canopy.
freeway: Freeways are wide linear strips of paved concrete with multiple lanes and clear markings. They differ from overpasses by being ground-level pavement rather than elevated structures; runways are shorter and lack lane divisions; railways show metal tracks rather than paved lanes.
golf_course: Golf courses are large green areas with mowed fairways, sand bunkers, and water hazards. They contrast with baseball diamonds by having fairways and bunkers rather than sports infields; meadows show natural grass without maintained features; lakes show water features without golf infrastructure.
ground_track_field: Ground track fields show oval running tracks with distinct lane markings and infield areas. They differ from stadiums by being track-focused fields rather than enclosed sports venues; baseball diamonds have diamond infields rather than oval tracks; railways show linear tracks rather than oval circuits.
harbor: Harbors show calm water areas enclosed by docks, piers, ships, and cranes. They differ from ships by being entire waterfront facilities rather than individual vessels; parking lots have vehicles rather than ships; beaches show natural sand without port infrastructure.
industrial_area: Industrial areas feature large warehouses, factories, and smokestacks. They differ from thermal power stations by having diverse factories rather than power generation; storage tanks show circular metallic containers rather than factory buildings; commercial areas show retail rather than industrial structures.
intersection: Intersections show cross-shaped road junctions with clear pavement markings. They contrast with roundabouts by having perpendicular crossing geometry rather than circular flow; freeways are continuous corridors rather than local junctions; overpasses show elevated structures rather than ground-level crossings.
island: Islands show land masses completely surrounded by water with visible shorelines. They differ from beaches by being entire landforms rather than shoreline strips; rivers show flowing water channels rather than land; sea ice shows frozen surfaces rather than solid land.
lake: Lakes appear as large, enclosed water bodies with smooth surfaces and irregular shorelines. They contrast with wetlands by having open water rather than water-saturated ground; sea ice shows frozen surfaces rather than open water; rivers show flowing channels rather than still water.
meadow: Meadows show open, grassy areas with smooth texture and scattered trees. They contrast with forests by having open grass rather than dense canopy; rectangular farmland shows organized crop rows; golf courses have maintained fairways and bunkers rather than natural grass.
medium_residential: Medium residential shows moderately sized houses on medium lots with visible yards. It differs from dense residential by having larger lots; sparse residential shows wider spacing; mobile home parks show trailer units rather than permanent houses.
mobile_home_park: Mobile home parks show rows of small, narrow rectangular trailer units in dense clusters. They contrast with medium residential by having trailer units rather than permanent houses; dense residential shows permanent housing; storage tanks show metallic containers rather than trailers.
mountain: Mountains show elevated, rugged terrain with steep slopes and rocky outcrops. They contrast with deserts by having rocky peaks rather than sand dunes; snowberg shows snow-covered peaks; forests show tree cover without dramatic elevation.
overpass: Overpasses are elevated road segments supported by pillars crossing above other roads. They differ from freeways by being raised structures rather than ground-level pavement; bridges span over water rather than land; railways show ground-level tracks rather than elevated roads.
palace: Palaces show ornate, large-scale architecture with grand courtyards and gardens. They differ from churches by lacking religious spires; commercial areas show modern retail buildings; tennis courts show sports facilities rather than palace grounds.
parking_lot: Parking lots are flat, paved areas with rows of parked vehicles in organized lanes. They contrast with harbors by having vehicles rather than ships; industrial areas have buildings alongside parking; airports show runways and aircraft rather than just vehicle storage.
railway: Railways show linear track corridors with parallel metal rails and ties. They differ from railway stations by being track corridors rather than full station facilities; freeways show paved vehicle lanes rather than metal rails; bridges are elevated crossing structures.
railway_station: Railway stations show tracks, platforms, passenger buildings, and surrounding parking. They contrast with industrial areas by having passenger platforms rather than factories; airports have runways and terminals rather than train tracks; viaducts show elevated rail structures rather than ground-level stations.
rectangular_farmland: Rectangular farmland shows large agricultural fields with straight, geometric boundaries. It differs from circular farmland by having rectangular geometry; terraces show stepped patterns on slopes; meadows show natural grass without crop rows.
river: Rivers appear as narrow, sinuous, dark water channels with flowing patterns. They contrast with lakes by being elongated flowing water; wetlands show saturated ground rather than flowing channels; bridges are structures spanning rivers.
roundabout: Roundabouts show circular road junctions with a central island and circulating lanes. They differ from intersections by having circular flow rather than perpendicular crossing; parking lots show vehicle storage rather than road circles; overpasses show elevated structures rather than ground-level circles.
runway: Runways are long, straight, wide paved strips with clear parallel markings. They contrast with freeways by being shorter with aircraft markings; airports show terminal buildings alongside runways; parking lots show vehicle rows rather than runway pavement.
sea_ice: Sea ice appears as vast, white to light blue frozen surfaces with irregular cracks. It differs from lakes by being frozen rather than open water; snowberg shows snow on land rather than sea ice; beaches show sandy shorelines rather than frozen surfaces.
ship: Ships appear as large watercraft with distinct hulls and superstructures. They differ from harbors by being individual vessels rather than waterfront facilities; islands show solid land rather than watercraft; sea ice shows frozen surfaces without vessels.
snowberg: Snowbergs show mountain peaks covered with white snow with exposed rock faces. They differ from mountains by having snow cover rather than exposed rock; sea ice shows flat frozen surfaces rather than peaks; clouds show soft atmospheric formations rather than solid peaks.
sparse_residential: Sparse residential shows widely separated houses surrounded by large vegetated lots. It contrasts with medium residential by having larger lot sizes; forests show tree cover without houses; rectangular farmland shows agricultural fields rather than houses.
stadium: Stadiums show large sports venues with oval shape, tiered seating, and surrounding parking. They contrast with ground track fields by having enclosed stands; baseball diamonds have sports field markings without stands; playgrounds are much smaller recreational areas.
storage_tank: Storage tanks appear as large circular metallic containers with domed or flat roofs. They differ from thermal power stations by being tank clusters rather than power generation; circular farmland shows crop patterns rather than metallic containers; industrial areas show factories rather than tank farms.
tennis_court: Tennis courts are rectangular playing areas with visible nets and court lines. They differ from basketball courts by having nets and different markings; parking lots show vehicle rows rather than court surfaces; mobile home parks show trailer units rather than sports courts.
terrace: Terraces show stepped agricultural or landscape patterns on slopes with visible contour lines. They differ from rectangular farmland by having stepped geometry on slopes; circular farmland shows pivot irrigation patterns; ground track fields show oval running tracks rather than terraced slopes.
thermal_power_station: Thermal power stations show large cooling towers, steam plumes, and industrial buildings. They differ from storage tanks by having cooling towers rather than tank clusters; industrial areas show diverse factories; commercial areas show retail buildings rather than power plants.
wetland: Wetlands show water-saturated ground with emergent vegetation and marshy textures. They contrast with lakes by having marsh vegetation rather than open water; rivers show flowing channels rather than saturated ground; meadows show dry grass without water saturation.
